firmware.title: 386 PC
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, DnCraptor
firmware.description: An i386 PC on Tiny386 that boots MS-DOS, Windows 3.x and 95, with Sound Blaster 16 and AdLib. Disks swap from the SD card.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard and mouse, NES pad as mouse. Win+F11: settings, Win+F12: disks.
